headline: State Minister Abdul Bari injured in road accident in Bogura
summary: The State Minister for Public Administration and Food was injured after his vehicle veered off the road into a paddy field while trying to save a pedestrian.
details: State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari, was involved in a road accident in Shibganj, Bogura, on Friday morning while traveling on an official visit to Kalai, Joypurhat.

The accident occurred around 9:00 AM near the Kichak Bridge. The vehicle lost control and plunged into a roadside paddy field while attempting to avoid hitting a woman who suddenly appeared on the road.
The pedestrian, identified as 55-year-old Firoza Begum from Gadgari village, was injured in the incident and was rushed to Zia Medical College Hospital for treatment.
State Minister Abdul Bari and his gunman, Muktarul, were also injured. The Minister was rescued by Kalai Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Saidul Alam and taken to Kalai Hospital.
According to OC Saidul Alam, the Minister did not sustain any serious injuries and only had minor marks of injury on his leg.
caption:
A State Minister's car plunged into a paddy field while trying to save a pedestrian. Three people were injured.

State Minister for Public Administration and Food, Abdul Bari, was involved in a road accident in Shibganj, Bogura, on Friday morning while traveling on an official visit to Kalai, Joypurhat.

The accident occurred around 9:00 AM near the Kichak Bridge. The vehicle lost control and plunged into a roadside paddy field while attempting to avoid hitting a woman who suddenly appeared on the road.

The pedestrian, identified as 55-year-old Firoza Begum from Gadgari village, was injured in the incident and was rushed to Zia Medical College Hospital for treatment.

State Minister Abdul Bari and his gunman, Muktarul, were also injured. The Minister was rescued by Kalai Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Saidul Alam and taken to Kalai Hospital.

According to OC Saidul Alam, the Minister did not sustain any serious injuries and only had minor marks of injury on his leg.

headline: Tk 276.30 crore embezzlement: ACC approves case against Hasina, Rehana
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has initiated a case over the alleged misappropriation of CSR funds intended for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved a case against ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina and her sister Sheikh Rehana.
The case involves the alleged embezzlement of Tk 276.30 crore in corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds meant for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.
The funds were reportedly collected from various banks as CSR contributions for the trust.
Former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder has been named as the third accused in the case.
ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing at the commission's headquarters.
caption:
Tk 276.30 crore in CSR funds allegedly embezzled. The ACC has now approved a case against Sheikh Hasina and Sheikh Rehana.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has approved a case against ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina and her sister Sheikh Rehana.

The case involves the alleged embezzlement of Tk 276.30 crore in corporate social responsibility (CSR) funds meant for the Bangabandhu Memorial Trust.

The funds were reportedly collected from various banks as CSR contributions for the trust.

Former Exim Bank chairman Mohammad Nazrul Islam Mazumder has been named as the third accused in the case.

ACC Secretary Saidur Rahman Khan confirmed the development during a press briefing at the commission's headquarters.
